pending.docs/design/memory-inplace-edit.md: owner-approved design in PR #3677; layout implementation owned by PR #3666

batches.title: What reaches the user: needs-you, questions, push
batches.scope: The attention surfaces of the phase 1 graduation criteria: the needs-you tray, question cards and their lifecycle, and phone push. Research Ikaga, Duet, Codex CLI and t3code first; design the tray and card states and the delivery and dedupe rules.

batches.title: Thread control and the merge decision
batches.scope: What a user can do to a running thread and how the gate verdict shows: steer, queue, stop, stop-and-done, plan approval with auto-approve, review rejection, and the merge controls with the gate verdict. Research Amp, Claude Code and t3code; design the state machine and the panels.

batches.title: Execution isolation: orbs, the agent's computer, own-key sandboxes
batches.scope: The per-task orb differentiator and the execution targets : how a user sees and chooses where a thread runs, the agent's own computer and its screen, and E2B or Daytona with the user's key. Land the coordinator-computer note, then write the backend design and the machine-page and screen designs.

batches.title: Remote access and device and machine auth
batches.scope: Reaching cairn from the owner's other devices and adding machines: the tsnet route list and pairing page, seamless login from tailnet devices, and the browser machine-authorize flow. Design the pages and the enroll and pairing failure modes.

batches.title: Install to first PR: desktop app, first run, mobile web
batches.scope: The phase 2 graduation path: a stranger installs the desktop app and gets a merged PR in 10 minutes, then uses it from a phone browser. Research the desktop shells and mobile web, and design the app packaging, the first-run checklist backend and the mobile layout.

batches.title: Recurring and finding work: schedules, search, sidebar
batches.scope: Scheduled tasks, the search syntax, and the sidebar with unread marks. Research Amp, Claude Code scheduled tasks and t3code, and design the due-event model, the search index and the unread state.

batches.title: Composer and attachments
batches.scope: Everything typed or attached before a message is sent: mentions, slash commands, named prompts, drafts that survive a restart and attachments. Research claude.ai, Amp and t3code; design the draft and attachment model.

batches.title: Execution settings: skills, MCP, harness profile, quota wait
batches.scope: Settings that change how harnesses run on each machine: skills, MCP servers, the opt-in harness profile of spec 30, and quota waits when a subscription runs out. Research t3code and Amp settings and write the missing designs.

batches.title: Access settings: secrets, API keys, account and team
batches.scope: Who can do what and with which credentials: the secrets page, API keys with grants, account and team settings with PR attribution. Design the pages and the key and grant model.

batches.title: Peripheral surfaces
batches.scope: Small surfaces that work today without research or design: the Coordinator MCP face for external harnesses, built-in git hosting, server backup and deploy banners, and thread tags. Each needs a short note and a design, or a decision to retire it.

batches.title: Phase 3: iOS app
batches.scope: Work for after phase 2 graduates: the native iOS app . Research and design only when phase 2 is close.

features.name: Coordinator chat
features.summary: The one never-ending Coordinator conversation on the home page, where the user dispatches work and reads reports.
features.states: Empty home with starters, streaming reply with a stop control, finished reply with an action row and, when the Coordinator offered them, quick-reply chips above the composer, and a connection-lost banner when the stream drops. A failed initial project greeting offers explicit retry with a reason, without inventing an owner message; pending, running, stale and ineligible retries are refused.
reach: type a request and press Enter

features.name: Reply quote
features.summary: Press Reply in your own message's hover tools to quote it above the composer. Coordinator messages have no reply arrow (owner decision, 2026-11-21); instead, select text in a Coordinator message to get a pill with Ask in side chat and Quote (R); Quote opens a one-input box where Enter stages the quote above the composer and Cmd+Enter sends it at once; Ask in side chat opens the related task thread with the selection quoted in its composer. The sent message carries the quote and its source message id.
features.states: Selection pill with and without a related task, quote box with its key hint, quote staged above the composer from your own message or a selection, source marked while the quote bar is hovered and unmarked once it is removed, sent bubble with the quote, side chat composer seeded with the quote, light and dark, 1440 and 390 wide.

features.name: Mailbox connector
features.summary: The owner connects an IMAP mailbox (QQ Mail authorization code, Gmail or Outlook app password). One held IDLE connection per mailbox turns new mail into a mail-provenance Coordinator turn with the mail fenced as untrusted data; replies go out over SMTP only after an approval card.
features.states: Mail cards under Available on the MCP page, then under Connected once a mailbox is connected, with a Manage dialog; connecting, connected, error (rejected login or unreachable server, with the reason), a last-mail time, wake rules (all new mail or matching sender/subject), and an approval card for every reply.

research.na: the binding contract is docs/design/mail-connector.md; no reference product is copied
